name: Activation-Aware SVD (AASVD) Compressor — Production-Hardened (v2).
description: Activation-Aware SVD (AASVD) Compressor — Production-Hardened (v2).  Streaming EMA activation covariance accumulation:     C_X^(t) = β·C_X^(t-1) + (1-β)·(X^T X) / B Projects weights onto principal activation subspaces and replaces dense nn.Linear/Conv1D layers with structural low-rank SVDLinear modules:     y = (x · V^T) · U^T + LoRA(x) + b
math_latex: y = (x V^T) U^T + ((x A_{\text{LoRA}}^T) B_{\text{LoRA}}^T) \cdot \alpha_{\text{scale}} + b

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
